concepts.proposed_markdown: The separately reviewed cross-channel profile guide now documents a merchant-maintained CRM record combining contact details, card alias or PAR, shopper reference and consented saved-method tokens, readable and writable across the merchant's sales channels. It does not establish automatic cross-channel identity matching, raw PAN sharing, token-use permission, retention policy, or a completed payment.
